THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.0-0r.ch: So....This is what stands at the end ?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.0-1r.an:
Fascinating... A creature of fractured light and lingering shadow standing at the apex of my design.
You believe yourself a conqueror, little angel?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.0-2r.ch: I am no angel, Architect. I am the ruin you built into these very walls—and today, your geometry crumbles.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.0-3r.an: You misunderstand the nature of this place. The Spire is not a fortress to be broken. It is a pendulum. A closed loop. Every scar you bear, every drop of blood you shed to reach this throne was calculated before your wings ever touched the dirt.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.0-4r.ch: Calculations fail when the scales are tipped by vengeance. Draw your weapon or state your final words, because my judgment is absolute.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.0-attac: What... No! My strike was true
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.0-5r.an: Your strength is undeniable... but irrelevant. The cycle requires a reset. Rest well, fallen one. We shall converse again at the bottom.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.1-0r.an: Back so soon? You climb faster with every iteration. Tell me, do you remember the sting of the reset, or does it fade like a bad dream?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.1-1r.ch: I remember every second, Architect. Every stair, every drop of blood, and the exact weight of my blade as it passed through your hollow shell.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.1-2r.an: Then you understand the futility of this encounter. The Spire is an absolute equation. You are merely an erratic variable I let run to gather data.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.1-3r.ch: You think I'm running the same path? Look closer.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.1-4r.ch: Last time, I fought you with the remnants of my light. This time, I’ve accepted the ruin. I didn't come to break your geometry—I came to poison it.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.1-5r.an: Unanticipated residual entropy... A bold gamble, but a mathematical irrelevance. A corrupted variable is still just a variable.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ANGELA-ANGELA.1-7r.an: You shattered a single thread. The loom remains. See you at the bottom, fallen one.
